integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, one continuous 10-second shot inside an old regional train moving through open countryside on a summer afternoon. A young man in a faded blue shirt sits alone beside an open window, wearing wired headphones and resting one elbow on the window frame. The camera holds a medium profile from across the aisle and slowly pushes in. Sunlight flickers rhythmically across his face as trees pass outside, alternating between warm light and soft shadow. His hair and shirt collar move gently in the incoming wind. He watches distant green fields, taps one finger quietly against his knee, then removes one headphone at 00:06.000 to listen to the real sound of the train and countryside. He leans slightly closer to the window and smiles at something passing outside. Keep the movement understated, the scenery naturally blurred, and the carriage softly aged. No dialogue, no readable signs, and no cuts.

overall_soundscape: Train wheels maintain a steady metallic rhythm beneath rail-joint clicks, window wind, subtle carriage vibration, distant birds, and fabric movement.

non_diegetic_music: Sparse upright-piano chords at a slow tempo with soft brushed drums and a warm sustained bass note, gradually decreasing in volume near the end.
